_comment: Every dataset-independent number and default rule the generation algorithm uses. Retune here — never in generate.py, SKILL.md, or CLAUDE.md. Dataset-specific knowledge (field names, tiers, muscle mapping) lives in ../datasets.json instead. Prose rationale: docs/generation.md.
_trailer_comment: What the trailer_groups_last order rule means. Travels in the brief; the coach applies it.
_brief_comment: How many candidates each muscle group offers, and how session length plus rest becomes an exercise ceiling. session_minutes_floor takes the low end of each bucket, so the ceiling is the one that fits the shortest session the answer allows.
_floor_comment: The one training rule the generator enforces — coaching.md 1.4. Scoped to the goals that include muscle growth, exactly as that rule scopes itself.
